text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing.
Neo Universe was staring fixedly at a single point—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whatcha wanna do now?
Karaoke? Or should we hit a dessert buffet too?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good! Also, umm...
there's this prize I really want from the arcade...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...'Probably'.
But for Neo Universe, it's 'unclear'."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Objective, method—"unknown."
Hence, we cannot do it "together."

Could it be that she can't hang out with me
because she isn't used to having fun...?
choice_data_list: Then let's go discover some fun!

text_block_list.text: "First up was karaoke. After I explained how to play in scoring mode—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Pitch, rhythm, technical alignment... Can they be turned into numbers?
If so, Neo Universe's "wavelength" is—

text_block_list.name: Karaoke Machine
text_block_list.text: "100 points! An impeccable singing voice!"

text_block_list.name: Game Machine
text_block_list.text: "Complete! New High Score!"

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, every single bullet hit the monster?!
A sniper... No, are they a genius gunslinger?!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Comparing the types and concentrations of moisturizing ingredients
against the prices, Product B is the optimal solution—
which is to say, the "best deal."

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text: T-That's so helpful~~...!
And so, Neo Universe continued to surprise people everywhere she went...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
is Neo Universe's way of playing the 'correct answer'?
Forget whether that's the right answer—racking up high scores everywhere and knowing so much about everything...
choice_data_list: Could it be that you've already played it to death...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
No...
It was "unclear" to Neo Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The 'karaoke' 'aligned' Neo Universe's 'wavelength'
with the machine's 'spectrum'.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
At the arcade, I analyzed the "algorithms"—
most of their movement patterns were just
applications of sine curves.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Cosmetics are Neo Universe's "INTI".
Nothing out of the ordinary.
If she could instantly grasp the mechanics of the game right then and there and adapt to it—
choice_data_list: You're a master of having fun at that point...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
choice_data_list: Let's play with everyone and surprise them!
It was presumptuous of me to think I could teach you how to have fun...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Next is "MUTX"—
Neo Universe is a little "nervous" too, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Still, that "longing"...
I'll definitely make it a reality.

I cheer on an enthusiastic Neo Universe.
I looked forward to the day I would see her
hanging out with friends in town.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
? Why?
Neo Universe is 『happy』.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Because looking at Neo Universe, Trainer,
Filled me with so much 'joy'."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Let's play again sometime.

"Neo Universe's words bring a sharp sting
to the back of my nose. I made a promise
with her, to surely meet again."
